review.identity: sonnet-1 (implementing agent, Rally task #1458 regeneration; not independently reviewed)
review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail and gpu capabilities; this harness derives every field from the recorded log, production discovery of $CS_GAME_DIR, and a second production spawn of the documented C1C + bloodhawk playtest scene whose texture report is serialised as decal-report.json (the measured decal-group attribution). Claim is implemented only: the keyed-coverage classification and the 1 cm geometric offset are DESIGNED development rules over production readers — the original engine's own decal rule (draw order, stored flag or its own offset) was not measured and is recorded as unknown in docs/findings/2026-10-08-playtest-decal-zfight.md. LIMITS: (1) no original executable was run, so nothing here is evidence of the original's runtime behaviour; (2) two keyed layers coplanar with each other would both take the offset and could still tie — none was measured to; (3) polygon field unk04 correlates with logo polygons but does not separate them, so its meaning stays unknown. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
